title: Settings Screen From Design System
intent: Build a settings app screen using the approved components and design system tokens only.
notes: Checks whether an app-building UI request derives a design-system workflow from component and token evidence.

title: Animated Onboarding Intro
intent: Build an animated onboarding app intro with a premium logo reveal and reusable Lottie controls.
notes: Checks whether an app-building animation request derives a motion workflow from SVG evidence and motion terms.

title: Mixed UI And Motion Onboarding Flow
intent: Build a polished onboarding app flow using the design system and a logo reveal animation.
notes: Checks whether one app request can compose multiple domain packs instead of choosing one hard-coded harness branch.

title: Full-Stack Habit Tracker PRD
intent: Build a full-stack habit tracker app with API routes, persistence, tests, and a deployable architecture workflow from this PRD.
notes: Checks whether a full-stack app PRD resolves the app-building pack and emits UI, API, persistence, source-tree, test, acceptance, and deployment-planning artifacts.
